notes: two sayings (rule 4a): the description of the Arabs' circumambulation, relayed through the unnamed father «أبيه» (saying 1), and Aisha's account of the Hums, which Hisham takes from «أبي» («قال هشام فحدثني أبي عن عائشة») (saying 2)
«حدثنا أبو كريب ... هشام» is written again for the second saying (rule 4a: shared head kept, tail null)
the Qur'anic verse quoted inside saying 2 is part of the saying, not a link
